sn56.2:1.4: idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn56.2:2.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yogo karaṇīyo ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yogo karaṇīyo ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
